content: The function E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> shall invoke the E2E_SMCheck() function, passing to that function the configuration object of type E2E_SMConfigType (see [SWS_E2EXf_00126] and [SWS_E2EXf_00088])and state object of type E2E_SMCheckStateType (see [SWS_E2EXf_00125]) that are associ- ated with <transformerId>, plus the profile-independent check status that was com- puted by E2E_PXXMapStatusToSM() in SWS_E2EXf_00029.
